description: This Python source file defines the LLMContext class responsible for managing conversation context, message handling, and multimedia content (images, audio) for large language models in the Pipecat framework. It includes methods for creating, manipulating, and storing messages, as well as for encoding multimedia data and integrating with external OpenAI types, making it central to the context handling subsystem for LLM services.

classes.name: LLMSpecificMessage
classes.description: A container for a context message that is specific to a particular LLM service, enabling use of service-specific message types while maintaining compatibility with the universal LLM context format.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for LLM interactions, supporting message history, tool definitions, multimedia content, and providing methods for message manipulation and content formatting. It includes methods for creating and adding image/audio messages and for normalization and validation of tools.
